turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
To ask about the past, we also need to know how finished actions look.
Look: Today I jump. Yesterday I jumped. For a regular verb, add -ed to talk about a finished action.
Right: They helped Anna. Wrong: They help Anna yesterday.
Now you try. Write the verb: Yesterday we (open) the window.
